aggregation_contract.conditional_estimates: Report success-conditional estimates and unestimable groups explicitly; do not replace missing estimates with zero
aggregation_contract.dependence: Target clustering contains within-target assay/family repeats; shared chemistry and related targets can still correlate across clusters
aggregation_contract.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty for sampled targets, not proof of broad generalization or calibrated activity probability
aggregation_contract.missing_scores: Keep every selected pair; missing/failed scores enter pessimistic and optimistic ranking bounds
aggregation_contract.uncertainty_unit: Resample target groups only, never query-control pairs, assays or conformer seeds as independent targets
aggregation_contract.weights: Equal child weights at each level; contexts within an assay cannot give that assay extra target weight
